title: Allow manually re-ordering tray icons
line: System Tray icons can now be put in any order by dragging them in the System Tray settings.
explanation: The System Tray always sorted its icons by category (and then by name), and the Entries settings page only listed them grouped by category, so there was no way to put, say, the VPN icon next to the network one. Open MR plasma-workspace!6958 (head b52d9fe8) adds an ordering mode to the Entries page: in "Manual order" the categories go away and every entry gets a drag handle (also keyboard-movable through Kirigami's ListItemDragHandle), the order is saved in the new iconOrder/manualIconOrder settings and used by the tray's sorting model, and a Reset Order action returns to the automatic order. This branch is that MR squashed onto the rig's base.

commits.message:
applets/systemtray: allow manually reordering icons

Tray icons were always sorted by category, with no way to put them in
the order you want. The Entries page now has a manual order mode where
entries can be dragged or moved with the keyboard, plus a reset action.

BUG: 384782
